import java.util.*;

public class Cutting {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int b = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] a = new int[n + 1];
        int[] evenCount = new int[n + 1];
        int[] oddCount = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1;
                oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1];
            } else {
                oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1;
                evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1];
            }
        }

        scanner.close();

        List<Integer> differences = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int j = 2; j < n; j++) {
            int diff = Math.abs(a[j] - a[j + 1]);
            if (evenCount[j] == oddCount[j]) {
                differences.add(diff);
            }
        }

        Collections.sort(differences);

        int totalCuts = 0;
        for (int diff : differences) {
            if (b >= diff) {
                b -= diff;
                totalCuts++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(totalCuts);
    }
}
